Subject: Headcount request: Senior Inference Engineer (backfill) - open req + interview slate

Team —

Requesting approval to open a backfill requisition for Senior Inference Engineer (IC4). This role supports the Serving Runtime reliability work in Q3; leaving the seat unfilled will create a 20% gap in on-call coverage and delay two planned infra optimizations (KV cache eviction and batching improvements).

Why now:
- Critical on-call coverage gap after Rohan's departure (last week).
- Work is high-priority for Dedicated product SLA commitments (customer escalations).
- We have two pre-screened candidates from our bench plus TalentBridge has an active slate.

Proposed ask:
1) Greenlight to open the req and post today (I attached the JD and shortlists).
2) Interview window: May 3–21 (three-week window) — internal panel + take-home exercise + 1-hour loop.
3) Budget: IC4 band, target base $190–220k + eq; if we need to move to top-of-band we should route through Markus.

Next steps if approved:
- Marissa to kick off req in Lever and book the panel.
- Marissa/Hannah to start scheduling candidate interviews.
- Karthik to draft a 1-pager on expected deliverables for the first 90 days to align hiring manager expectations.

Attachments: JD_Senior_Inference_Engineer_v2.docx; CandidateShortlist_Q2_2027.xlsx

Thanks —
Soojin
